codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: Does Break and Steal an Egg have codes?
items.answer: No. As of October 12, 2026 the game has no text code box at all. Free rewards come from linking your Discord account in the shop and liking the game plus joining its official group.

items.question: How do I get the Saber-tooth Egg for free?
items.answer: Join the official Discord from the game's Roblox page, then enter your Discord username in the shop's Discord verification section. The egg is claimed instantly.

items.question: What should I upgrade first?
items.answer: Speed. The whole game is a chase — speed wins steals and escapes. Pickaxe and pen capacity come next.

items.question: How many pets are in the game?
items.answer: Around 78 pets across the game's biomes, per early coverage — collectible through the in-game index, with more arriving in updates.
